cues: Salts are also classed by the p H of their solution.
Strong acid with strong base, neutral.
Weak acid with strong base, basic.
Strong acid with weak base, acidic.
And a careful point: an acid salt is not the same as an acidic salt.
Sodium bicarbonate is an acid salt by composition, but its solution is alkaline.
